title: Chip stocks see $2.3 trillion weekly wipeout as panic grips the AI trade
html:
A major semiconductor index just posted its worst weekly performance in 25 years

The chip sector’s worst week in a quarter-century saw $2.3 trillion in market capitalization evaporate.

The PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX plunged 10.7% on Friday, erasing $1.3 trillion in market cap in a single session, according to Dow Jones Market Data. That decline helped carry the index to its worst weekly performance since Sept. 21, 2001, according to Dow Jones Market Data. It fell 17.1% this week.
summary: A major semiconductor index just posted its worst weekly performance in 25 years.
